diagnosis: The checks C1 and C2 passed because the lone decision-maker could access PF1 and PF2, respectively. Specifically, the HLA crossmatch in PF1 provided the justification for releasing the platelet dose to Patient Cedar, and the cellular-therapy requirement in PF2 specified the exact irradiation and leukoreduction requirements. These facts were accessible even without any conversation or shared private information from other agents.

C1.why: The HLA crossmatch changes the recipient from an unresolved choice between Patient Cedar and Patient Maple to Patient Cedar, and supplies the specific justification for that release.

C2.why: The cellular-therapy requirement changes the component record from unspecified precautions to exactly irradiated and leukoreduced.
